description: This file defines a Java interface named IndelUpdate which represents updates consisting of insertions and deletions, providing methods for manipulating and exporting these updates, used within a pub/sub data handling context.

classes.name: IndelUpdate
classes.description: An interface for representing updates that include insertions and deletions with thread safety considerations, providing methods to reset, snapshot, export, and modify the update set.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all data within the update, destroying immutability.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Exports an unmodifiable copy of the current update.

methods.name: exportAndReset
methods.description: Exports an unmodifiable copy of the current update and then resets the data, ensuring thread safety if no external references exist.

methods.name: getInserts
methods.description: Returns a set of elements that are currently inserted.

methods.name: getDeletes
methods.description: Returns a set of elements that are marked for deletion.

methods.name: shouldReplaceAll
methods.description: Indicates whether the update should clear all associations and replace them with insertions.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Adds an element to the set of inserts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds an element to the set of deletions.
